items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I worked on a bill with Donny Donagan at a club there.

ctx.x: Okay, so you were just working on the road?

Yeah, well you see, as I said before I was free-lancing more or less so different agents if they had work, if they had a trio and they wanted a feature singer they'd call me. So I'd probably go some place for a two-week engagement in a club or wind up in some theater on a bill, you know, fill in. So I kept pretty busy up until 1957. I was tired in 1957. I really had it. I remember I wound up in Des Moines, Iowa, one leg of a long jump. I worked on a bill with Donny Donagan at a club there. And business wasn't…
